propositions: The structural guard test scans only transport.py, but commit 465d moved all search_issues call sites to _base.py and _issues.py, leaving the guard's target file empty and causing the predicate to return zero offenders unconditionally.
The hardcoded single-file scan path _TRANSPORT_SRC was never updated when the module was split, so the guard cannot detect unpaginated search_issues calls added to other modules in the adapter.
The guard must scan the entire adapters/jira_datacenter/ package directory instead of a single file, and must assert that the scan population is non-zero to prevent future rot from silent disarming.
Two existing search_issues call sites in _base.py:172 and _issues.py:262 already pass explicit maxResults caps and will remain compliant when the scan is widened.
The repair requires a teeth test proving the widened predicate detects an uncapped call in a non-transport module, confirming the directory-level scan is exercised.
An audit sweep identified four other single-file AST structural guards that were emptied by the same module split and require separate repair tickets.
